description: This file defines classes and traits related to V1 fallback writers for Spark SQL data sources, including append and overwrite operations, and helper interfaces for V1 write semantics.

classes.name: AppendDataExecV1
classes.description: Physical plan node for appending data into a V2 table using V1 write interfaces.

classes.name: OverwriteByExpressionExecV1
classes.description: Physical plan node for overwriting data in a V2 table with V1 write interfaces, with behavior depending on the target data source.

classes.name: V1FallbackWriters
classes.description: Sealed trait providing V2 write semantics through V1 writer interface, including metrics collection and execution logic.

classes.name: SupportsV1Write
classes.description: Trait allowing tables using V1 writer interfaces to append data.

methods.name: run
methods.description: Executes the write operation, updates metrics, and refreshes cache.

methods.name: writeWithV1
methods.description: Helper method to insert data into a relation using V1 interface.
